name: change-with-tests
description: An agent makes a code change; a script runs the tests; a person approves or rejects the diff.

inputs.name: test_command
inputs.description: Command that must pass, e.g. npm test

steps.description: Record the starting commit and refuse a dirty tree.
Make this change in the working tree, without committing: {{ request }}. Then submit a one-line summary.
Run the test command. The run fails here until it passes.
A person reviews the change (git diff {{ setup.base }}) and approves or rejects it.
End the run as failed unless the person approved.
